lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Sergio Adamczyk is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Sergio Adamczyk is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Sergio kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Sergio's gone." Ryan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Sergio." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Raj blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Sergio Adamczyk, 41 days. The mantle passes to Raj Banks.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Raj Banks, 20 — a florist. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Green Whisper.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Sergio — and Sergio is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Ryan, Emily, Anna and 5 more speak for Raj — "Sergio trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Raj before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
